Name: Datazag
Author: Datazag - support@datazag.com
Description:
The [Datazag](https://datazag.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel delivers brand impersonation, platform impersonation and attacker-infrastructure indicators derived from Certificate Transparency, published as STIX 2.1 objects over a TAXII 2.1 server.

Indicators are ingested using Microsoft Sentinel's built-in **Threat Intelligence - TAXII** data connector and land in the native **ThreatIntelIndicators** table. No custom table, data collection rule or workspace function is required, and indicators are available to analytic rules and hunting queries immediately. Because indicators are retained in the workspace, existing logs can also be retro-hunted against them. Datazag never queries your workspace: delivery is pull-only, on a schedule you control.

**Before you install**

You need an active Datazag subscription. Contact support@datazag.com to obtain the username and password for your organisation, quoting the collections your subscription includes.

**Connecting the feed**

In the Microsoft Defender portal, go to Microsoft Sentinel > Configuration > Data connectors, open **Threat Intelligence - TAXII**, select **Open connector page**, then **Add**. Enter a friendly name of your choosing, the API root URL and collection ID below, and the credentials issued by Datazag. A polling frequency of once an hour is recommended. Repeat for each collection your subscription includes; each is a separate TAXII server entry.

API root URL: `https://taxii.datazag.com/api/`

| Collection | ID |
|---|---|
| Platform impersonation | `c7ad8fef-c704-4b36-9526-5d7c3bd018c4` |
| Attacker infrastructure | `eedf8709-5e4f-4ed4-b840-5eaafa236b70` |

Brand impersonation collections are issued per organisation; Datazag will supply your collection ID with your credentials.

**Prerequisites**

a. An active Datazag subscription and TAXII credentials, as above.

b. The analytic rule and hunting query in this solution match indicators against DNS activity through the [Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM)](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/normalization). The ASIM DNS parsers must be deployed and the workspace must be receiving DNS telemetry for this content to return results.

Content in this solution identifies Datazag indicators by their STIX `created_by_ref` rather than by `SourceSystem`, because `SourceSystem` reflects the friendly name you choose when adding the TAXII server.
